outcome: composite adverse neonatal outcome (neurological morbidity, neonatal respiratory assistance, RDS, NEC, sepsis, blood transfusion, phototherapy, hypoglycemia, neonatal death)
composite severe adverse neonatal outcome (neurological morbidity, blood transfusion, NEC, sepsis, RDS, neonatal death)
cohort: The study included all pregnancies diagnosed with fetal growth restriction (birthweight <10th percentile) at 24-42 weeks of gestation between 2008 and 2019.
finding: Histologic chorioamnionitis in pregnancies complicated by fetal growth restriction was independently associated with higher rates of composite adverse neonatal outcomes and severe composite adverse neonatal outcomes.
